Trinity Street Asset Management Llp sold 17,950 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 283,800 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $43.45M, down from 301,750 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trinity Street Asset Management Llp who had been investing in Whirlpool Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.76B market cap company.
